units.source_text: 源氏公子在镜台前照照自己的相貌，觉得很漂亮。

en.t: Prince Genji looked at his own face in the mirror stand and thought he was very handsome.

units.source_text: 他就拿起颜料笔来，在自己的鼻尖上点一点红。

en.t: Then he picked up a paintbrush and dabbed a little red on the tip of his nose.

units.source_text: 这等漂亮的相貌，加上了这一点红，也很难看。

en.t: Even such a handsome face looked quite ugly with that spot of red added to it.
Lady Murasaki saw it and could not stop laughing.

units.source_text: 公子问她：“假如我有了这个毛病，你怎么样？”

en.t: The prince asked her, "What would you do if I really had this defect?"
Lady Murasaki said, "I would not like it."

units.source_text: 她惧怕那红颜料就此染住，揩拭不脱，非常担心。

en.t: She was afraid the red pigment would stain him and not wipe off, and she became very worried.

units.source_text: 源氏公子假装揩拭了一会，认真地说：“哎呀，一点也揩不脱，玩出祸来了！

en.t: Prince Genji pretended to wipe it for a while, then said solemnly, "Oh no, it will not come off at all. This joke has turned into trouble!

units.source_text: 教父皇看见了怎么办呢？”

en.t: What shall I do if His Majesty my father sees it?"

units.source_text: 紫姬吓坏了，连忙拿纸片在水盂里蘸些水，替他揩拭。

en.t: Lady Murasaki was badly frightened and hurriedly took a scrap of paper, dipped it in the water bowl, and wiped it for him.

units.source_text: 源氏公子笑道：“你不要像平仲[\[23\]](#part1335.html#m23)那样误蘸了墨水！

en.t: Prince Genji laughed and said, "Do not dip it in ink by mistake like Heichu[\[23\]](#part1335.html#m23)!

units.source_text: 红鼻子还可勉强，黑鼻子太糟糕了。”

en.t: A red nose might still be bearable, but a black nose would be dreadful."

units.source_text: 两人如此玩耍，真是一对有趣的小夫妻。

en.t: The two of them played together like this, truly an amusing little married couple.
